slots.title: Is Redken Shampoo Safe? What L'Oreal Asked New York State For (2026)
slots.why: L'Oreal USA. New York capped 1,4-dioxane in personal care at 1 ppm. Instead of meeting it, L'Oreal USA applied to the state for waivers on 69 salon products and got them, listing Redken All Soft Shampoo at 4.5 ppm, Redken Color Extend Graydiant at 3.67 ppm, Kerastase Densifique Women Bain at 4.6 ppm, and L'Oreal Professionnel Serie Expert Volumetry at 7.23 ppm. That is seven times the legal limit, in writing, on a government form, signed by the company.
slots.felt: Her hair changed. It went dry and flat and the gray came in wiry, so she stopped buying the drugstore bottle and started paying thirty-eight dollars at the salon because the stylist said the cheap stuff was the problem. She has been buying safety. That is what the price tag was for.

slots.title: Why Did Eggs Cost So Much? (2026)
slots.why: Cal-Maine Foods, the largest egg producer in America, along with Hickman's Egg Ranch and Versova. The Justice Department alleges they coordinated their bidding to push up the daily Urner Barry price quotation that sets what grocery stores pay for billions of eggs a year, including flooding the market with bids in the hours right before the quote published and placing bids unlikely to ever become real trades.
slots.felt: She stands in front of the egg case doing math. Eggs were the one cheap protein she could still count on, the thing she made when the week ran long and her knees hurt too much to cook properly. She assumed it was bird flu and she assumed there was nothing to be done about it.

slots.title: Why Does My Window Air Conditioner Smell? The Mold Recall Nobody Told Her About (2026)
slots.why: GD Midea Air-Conditioning Equipment Co. Ltd. of China. It built one unit and sold it under ten different names, so a woman who deliberately avoided the Chinese brand still bought the same machine: Midea, Frigidaire, Danby, Insignia, Keystone, Mr. Cool, Perfect Aire, Comfort Aire, Sea Breeze and LBG Products. CPSC found the design let water pool inside instead of draining, which is what grew the mold.
slots.felt: Every summer she wakes with a sore throat, a stuffy head and that heavy tired that coffee does not fix, and every summer she calls it allergies or getting older. The unit blowing on her while she sleeps has been in that bedroom window since 2020.

slots.title: Why Was The Laundress Recalled Twice? (2026)
slots.why: Conopco Inc., doing business as Unilever, maker of The Laundress. The brand was built on being the careful, gentle, premium choice and sold through Target, Nordstrom, Saks Fifth Avenue and Bloomingdale's, and it had to recall the same product line twice inside four months.
slots.felt: She paid four times the drugstore price for the pretty glass bottle because her skin got reactive somewhere around 48 and she decided the good sheets and her own body were worth the upgrade. She bought careful. Careful is what she thought she was paying for.
